## Imprison

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/buku_imprison.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user shuts the creature they look at inside a book from their bag. The creature must be under half its health and bosses can't be taken. Using the book on the ground lets the creature out and burning the book does too A player is shut in for 4 seconds and nothing touches them. Hitting the book lets them out sooner, and burning it does too but they come out burning The user goes into a book of their own for up to 4 seconds and nothing touches them. Using it again lets them out
